thesis_summary.thesis: Firefly Aerospace Inc. is a Nasdaq-listed U.S. space and defense technology company selling end-to-end mission solutions: small and medium launch (Alpha and Eclipse rockets), spacecraft (Blue Ghost lunar lander and Elytra orbital vehicles), and defense software and sensing (SciTec, acquired October 2025). **[Fact]** Customers are primarily U.S. national security agencies, NASA, and prime contractors. **[Fact]** FY2025 revenue was **$159.9 million** (+163% versus **$60.8 million** in FY2024). **[Fact]** Q1 2026 revenue was **$80.9 million** (+45% year-over-year versus **$55.9 million**). **[Fact]** The company had **1,409 employees** at December 31, 2025, including **436** with active national security clearances (10-K Item 1).
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: **Predictive attribute:** backlog versus burn (milestone cash collections versus operating losses).

key_assumptions.source: Yahoo Finance FLY regular market price 2026-07-18

key_assumptions.source: Normalized owner cash per share after growth capital spending and integration drag; FY2025 OCF $204.9M ($1.28/sh at ~160M shares) includes milestone/deferred-revenue timing and IPO-period collections not equal to run-rate equity free cash (10-K FY2025); Q1 2026 operating loss ($95.7M) and net loss ($96.7M) on revenue $80.9M (10-Q Q1 2026)
RPO converts on stated cadence; Alpha cadence improves; SciTec defense software cross-sell; gross margin expands from Q1 21.6% base
